An old [[Droid/Legends|droid]] foundry located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] was used as a '''base''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A [[Geonosis strike team (Rebel)|Rebel strike team]] attempted to [[Infiltration of Geonosis Imperial base|infiltrate]] the facility, but were captured. A later mission conducted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and [[X2]] [[Mission to Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] the Rebels.
